summary:
Patrick E. Proctor (born June 14, 1971) is an American politician serving as a member of the Kansas House of Representatives, representing the 41st district since 2021. First elected in 2020, Proctor's district includes Fort Leavenworth and Leavenworth, Kansas. 
Proctor is a retired United States Army colonel and the Republican Party nominee for Kansas Secretary of State in 2026.
